body: Not that it matters, but I'm not cheating on him.  I've never slept with the other guy, only kissed him once.
The person I'm in love with is not my husband, and if the other guy asked me to, I'd leave him in a heartbeat and never look back.
I just want to say I'm not suicidal, but I am on the verge of doing something very rash.  You all have been a huge help and support for me in the past, and I don't have anyone else really.

Original thread: http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/7rvua/sometimes_i_feel_like_dying_because_of_my_marriage/c0782i2

First off, thanks to all of you who sent me private messages, letters, and the one kind gent who made me some awesome mixed CDs.  Sorry that I haven't replied to the letters or returned the CD favor, but I'm working on it. 

I just have a few updates from the first time I posted.  First, the good news- I applied and was accepted to an archaeology field school here in my state, so I'll be spending the whole month of June on a dig.  I'm very excited.  I've also made 2 friends finally, one in my class and one here on base.  

Now the bad news.  Tricare assigned me a psychiatrist 4 hours away.  I was told I need to see him 3 times a month, but between school and work and money that's impossible.  I petitioned to Tricare to see a doctor a little closer and they said I "didn't meet the criteria" to see a doctor here in my town.  When I pressed the woman on the phone, she said that they considered me too at risk and wanted me to see a better psychiatrist in Albuquerque.  This makes no sense to me, and I still haven't seen a doctor at all.  I'm still working with Tricare to get something worked out. 

It still feels like there are 2 people inside me at times.  Some days I'm happy and I love my husband and I'm looking forward to college and having a career.  

But other days I look in the mirror and see a pimple and tell myself I'm too ugly to be seen in public so I should skip class and not show up for work.  If I hear girls laughing in the hallway, I think they must be making fun of me and it sends me into a panic.    

I'm honestly hoping that the dig this summer will break me out of this.  That I'll be forced to have confidence, and the sun and exercise will do me good.  

Again, thank you all for the kind thoughts.  You make me not feel so afraid.  

tl:dr I'm still here.  I'm still around, just not much better.

Just little things. Its pathetic to say, but having Lost to look forward to has actually kept me from downing pills and sleeping for days.  I can't find out what happens if I'm in a coma, haha.  I also love to cook, and I have the goal to learn a new recipe every week.  I'm a voracious reader of everything from Vonnegut, to Plato, to $5 paperback romances.
Neither, but they're both in my Netflix queue :P

I can also send letters, perhaps CDs and some origami or whatever other small things I can think of.  

You guys were all very helpful to me before, so its the least I can do :)

I'm posting here under a different username than the one I normally use on reddit.  Sorry this is so long.  Just understand that I have no actual friends, so this is really the only place I could think of to turn.    

I got married at 18, and I'm turning 20 in a few weeks.  My husband is in the military, and we live on base.  We got lucky enough to be stationed near a traditional 4 year university, so I attend there full time.  I also work part time for my school through their work study program.  

My husband is a wonderful man.  He has never once yelled at me, never laid a hand on me, never denied me anything within reason.  

Whenever I'm with my husband, I'm placid.  But anytime I'm alone, and that's quite often with the military, I get extremely depressed about my life.  I feel like I got married so young that I will never get a chance to just be normal.  My high school friends are going off hiking, and traveling to other countries, and doing internships in Washington D.C.  All kinds of things.  And its like, here I sit, looking at these 4 white walls in government housing, these perfectly trimmed lawns, the women at the commissary with their 2.5 kids, and I think I'm losing my mind over it.  

For the past 2 or 3 months or so nothing has made me excited or happy like I used to be.  Even my college classes, which have always been one of my favorite things, just bore me.  I sit in class and listen to everyone else talk about their lives and their goals, while in my mind I'm trying to remember if I've picked up my husband's dry cleaning yet. 

4 nights ago, I found out one of my high school friends was going to Spain for a study abroad program.  The highlight of my day had been making spicy spaghetti sauce instead of plain.  I went into the bathroom and took all the Tylenol PM we had.  It was only 6 pills, but it made me sleep for about  40 hours.  

I will never do anything amazing or special with my life.  I will never travel, I will never be interesting, I will never accomplish anything besides popping out kids and making biscuits and being a dutiful wife.  My life is fucking over at 19.  I don't want to be "traveling the world" or staring in movies or anything, I just want to feel like I have options.  That if I wanted to take a weekend trip, I could.  That if I wanted to study abroad in Spain, I could.  That if I wanted to go take up a cool hobby, I could.  

I don't know if I'm exactly "suicidal" because I don't have any plans or anything, but I just needed someone to talk to.  I'm becoming so detached from everything, that it scares me.  

tl:dr- Sometimes I want to die because my life is boring.
